description: This PHP test class `EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPITest` is a unit test for the `EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPI` class, focusing on the API endpoints related to employee license management within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes tests for methods like `getAll`, but also provisions for other CRUD operations which are expected to throw 'not implemented' exceptions.
